questions.answer:
```sql
DELIMITER //

CREATE TRIGGER student_sc_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON sc
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student WHERE sno = NEW.sno) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = '学生学号不存在';
    END IF;
END//

CREATE TRIGGER student_delete
AFTER DELETE ON student
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM sc WHERE sno = OLD.sno;
END//

CREATE TRIGGER student_sno
AFTER UPDATE ON student
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF NEW.sno <> OLD.sno THEN
        UPDATE sc SET sno = NEW.sno WHERE sno = OLD.sno;
    END IF;
END//

DELIMITER ;
```
questions.explanation: 原文档插入触发器在学号不存在时自动插入学生，这与题目的“给出错误提示”不一致；正确做法是使用 SIGNAL 拒绝操作。删除和更新触发器分别使用 OLD.sno 定位被影响的历史记录。
